issues.description: Open issue from the extension fixer, not fixed. A run's working copy is seeded from the user's live .lake/build with no coordination with the workspace's own Lean refresh. createRunShadow first lists .lake/build (collectBuildSeed). Afterwards it runs lstat and copyFile on each file, with no lock and no re-check. The workspace's refreshLeanFacts runs `lake build` in place under the semantic runExclusive lock, and seeding does not take that lock. If Lake rewrites the build in between, the start is refused with ENOENT; this happens after a save or Undo shortly before 'These suffice', and RunManager.start's own set-premises write also schedules a refresh. When the start is not refused, the build mirror can hold a snapshot of a build in progress: Lake's temporary files instead of the artifacts, and possibly artifacts from two builds. Lake may then trust that snapshot when it checks the run. This is a proof-integrity risk for the review verdict. The board's own refresh after Accept would still show the truth. The VS Code e2e test was changed to wait for idle Lean before each start, so no test exercises this race any more.
issues.evidence: Probe S/probes/probes/race.probe.ts, results in S/probes/out/race-result.json (S=/tmp/claude-1002/-home-zhengyew-telelean/03a29d54-7342-40e3-b5f0-2697a62c93ef/scratchpad/turn9/m2verify-r2). It uses the real createRunShadow and no Lean. A child process replaced one .lake/build file the way Lake does (rm, write .tmp, mv) while createRunShadow ran 10 times. 6 were refused with ShadowLayoutError 'cannot create the shadow: ENOENT' (3 at lstat, 3 at copyfile). 4 succeeded; 3 of those seeded only Lake's temporary file zz/victim.olean.tmp and no victim.olean. The extension fixer's full VS Code run hit the same refusal: 'startRun refused (not-yet): telelean could not make the run's working copy: cannot create the shadow: ENOENT … runs_e2e_model/.lake/build/ir/Model/Spyro/Vocabulary.c', right after an Undo had started a refresh. Code: packages/runner/src/shadow/index.ts:93-115 (listing), 148, 172-179 (lstat and copyFile; any error refuses the start); packages/runner/src/run/manager.ts:864 (set-premises write) and 880 (createShadow right after it); packages/runner/src/semantic/index.ts:46 (runExclusive, used only by refreshes); packages/extension/test/suite/e2e-runs.test.ts:173-176 (the test now waits for idle Lean).
issues.suggested_fix: Seed only from a quiescent build: run collectBuildSeed and the copy inside semantic.runExclusive, or behind a ModelWorkspace pause/whenIdle hook. Re-check each file's size and mtime after copying it, and skip Lake temp files. On any ENOENT or change, fall back to no seed instead of refusing the start: an empty build/.lake/build is always correct, only slower. Add a runner-level test that rewrites .lake/build during createRunShadow, like the probe.

issues.description: An `example` that Claude adds in a round that never froze is not judged by the gate. It reaches the user's files after a 'not proved' round even when it rests on an assumption the user did not select. Examples are judged only in the proof-before-freeze block, which runs for check (formalise) and freeze; gate-other has no example rule. decisions-log section 28 documents only 'an example written after the freeze'. User guide 10.6 says every proof Claude adds is held to the rule. There is no soundness impact: an example has no name, so nothing can use it.
issues.evidence: Probe X-14 (S/probes/out/carriers-result.json): new-spyro-pg not selected, Claude adds `example : PLift new_spyro_pg := ⟨new_spyro_pg.holds⟩`. check_lean says 'an `example` is a proof, written before freeze_statements: remove it.' Then finish(not_proved) gives 'Gate passed', verdict not-proved, and Accept wrote the example into the scratch user's Main.lean (line 59). Code: packages/core/src/gate/rules.ts:669 (the block's guard) and 705-721 (example rule). Also confirmed, documented and harmless: X-8 `structure HelperT where h : new_spyro_pg := by exact new_spyro_pg.holds` passes and is written. That field is an autoParam, so the structure holds tactic syntax and no proof term.
issues.suggested_fix: Refuse every new `example` at the gate in every purpose: nothing ever needs one in the user's files. At minimum, apply the existing example rule in gate-other when the round has no freeze. Fix the wording in decisions-log 28 and user guide 10.6.
